def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Equação empírica para log10(|ID|/A) ao longo da curva de transferência."""
    """Equation empirical for log10(|ID|/A) along the saturation regime of a p-channel OTFT."""
    
    a1, a2, a3, a4, b1, b2 = parameters[:6]
    c1, c2 = parameters[6:]
    
    linear_term = a1 + a2 * gate_voltage_abs
    exp_term = (a3 * np.exp(-b1 * gate_voltage_abs) + a4 * np.exp(-b2 * gate_voltage_abs))
    
    return linear_term + exp_term
